description: Sales Tax Collections by State (monthly) is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Research and Statistics", published or maintained by U.S. Census Bureau. Discontinued by U.S. Census Bureau. Last data are for March 2025. Monthly state sales tax collections is an experimental dataset published by the U.S. Census Bureau. It provides data for collections from sales taxes including motor fuel taxes. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Research and Statistics". It has 9 columns, among them numeric month, id, state, note, month, fips state. The portal shows 2026-07-06 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. Census Bureau. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
